title: Give each implemented train its own train:{theme}:{train_id} URN line on the theme orchestrator

facts.note: Theme orchestrator files live at python/trains/orchestrators/{theme}.py; any existing or new file matching this glob is in scope, whatever kind of change touches it.
Plan/wagon/WMBT/acceptance/doc text that mentions a theme orchestrator or the trains it implements.

values: orchestrator file missing a train:{theme}:{train_id} URN line for an implemented train
URN theme segment differs from orchestrator filename
facts.note: Needs an observer that pairs each orchestrator file with the trains it implements and compares them to its '# urn:' lines; applies to existing files as well as new ones.

fires: A plan or wagon assigns a new train to a theme, so python/trains/orchestrators/{theme}.py will implement it.
A planned orchestrator file implements several trains of the same theme.
A plan creates a new theme orchestrator file under python/trains/orchestrators/.
A plan edits an existing orchestrator's internal logic: the file must still carry one URN line per implemented train.
An existing orchestrator file implements a train but lacks its train:{theme}:{train_id} URN line (repair is required).
doesNotFire: Planning work only on files outside python/trains/orchestrators/ (e.g. wagon or train spec files themselves).
Trains that are registered but not implemented by any orchestrator file (no orchestrator URN line is due for them).

given: A theme orchestrator file python/trains/orchestrators/{theme}.py exists or is planned, and it implements one or more trains.
when: Any planning artifact or doc you author creates, changes (including internal-logic edits) or describes that orchestrator, or you find it missing URN lines.
then: Ensure the orchestrator file carries one `# urn: train:{theme}:{train_id}` line per implemented train, with {theme} matching the file's theme.
prefer: When one orchestrator implements several trains, plan multiple `# urn:` lines, one for each train.
When an existing orchestrator lacks a URN line for a train it implements, plan the missing line as part of the work.
avoid: A single combined or unprefixed URN line covering several trains.
URNs whose theme segment differs from the orchestrator's {theme} filename.
URN lines for trains the orchestrator does not actually implement, added only to satisfy a check.
why: The theme-prefixed orchestrator URN is what ties each implemented train to its theme orchestrator file, so every implemented train must be traceable by its own URN line.
evidence: For each python/trains/orchestrators/{theme}.py, every implemented train has exactly one `# urn: train:{theme}:{train_id}` line.
The {theme} segment of each URN equals the orchestrator filename stem.
verifier_detail: Term orchestrator_urn: the theme-prefixed train URN on an orchestrator file; pattern train:{theme}:{train_id}.
Files implementing multiple trains carry multiple `# urn:` lines (one per train).
Invariant is unconditional on file contents: check all orchestrator files, existing and new, regardless of the kind of change.
